name: Templates & Snippets
description: A gallery of reusable drawing templates. Insert a template as a new drawing or save the current canvas as a template.
author: Excalibur (first-party)

panels.title: Templates & Snippets
panels.body: Pick a starting point from the **Templates** panel, or save your current drawing as a reusable template. Templates are stored per-profile and can be seeded by the AI Import Lane (`template_pack` payloads).
